content: अप्रमाण {%a.%} .²1 Unlimited, immeasurable, boundless. .²2 Without authority, proof or weight, unauthorized. .²3 Not regarded as an authority, not trustworthy; आजन्मनः शाठ्यमशिक्षितो यस्तस्याप्रमाणं वचनं जनस्य <ls>Ś. 5. 25</ls>. .{@-णम्@} .²1 That which cannot be taken as authority in actions; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a rule, direction <ab>&c.</ab> which cannot be accepted as obligatory. .²2 Irrelevancy.
